title: Stabilize the versioned client API and generated contract
goal: Review and merge API v1 while preserving browser authentication and independent server operation.
acceptance: Verify generated OpenAPI/TypeScript matches the running authenticated backend.
Exercise native cookie/CSRF login, server compatibility, strict URL validation, expired sessions and protected ranges.
Validate search, track metadata flags and bounded diagnostic/capability reports.
Review the additive migration and preserve legacy browser functionality.

title: Define client SDK and ship a first Windows desktop client
goal: Ship the dedicated Tauri Windows alpha from this monorepo; continue existing issue #17 rather than duplicating it.
acceptance: Build a real native window with bundled React UI, server selection, login, library/details/search, Direct Play and Continue Watching.
Validate Credential Manager storage and actual-backend networking/ranges/progress/revocation.
Produce EXE/MSI artifacts and perform installer launch, high-DPI and WebView2 codec tests on physical Windows.
Scope native media controls, notifications, libmpv fallback and signed update follow-ups after measurements.

title: Build the native Android phone client with Compose, Media3 and Keystore
goal: Refine existing issue #18 into the next focused implementation PR; TV now has its own issue.
acceptance: Implement the modules and staged PR plan in docs/clients/ANDROID.md using the same v1 API.
Protect session cookies with Keystore-backed AES-GCM; enforce TLS and clear credentials on logout.
Validate Compose connection/library/details and real Media3 playback/resume, rotations and session expiry against the actual backend.
Build installable debug APK plus unsigned release APK/AAB; document signing and add an independent Gradle workflow.
Do not add offline downloads before server authorization/download design.

title: Implement authenticated playback handoff between devices
goal: Resume a current stream on a second authorized client.
acceptance: Use expiring single-use handoff requests, never raw media-path URLs.
Enforce user/device permissions and opt-in confirmation on destination.
Transfer position and selected tracks, handle stale/offline devices and avoid duplicate playback.
Extend revision/conflict tests across Windows and Android; never silently replay stale offline positions.

title: Implement a dedicated Android TV interface over shared Android layers
goal: Build a ten-foot experience after the phone network/authentication/playback modules work.
acceptance: Share Kotlin security, network and Media3 modules; implement a separate TV UI.
Test D-pad focus restoration, remote controls, Continue Watching, reconnect and track-capability behavior.
Keep discovery untrusted until TLS identity is verified; design expiring pairing challenges separately.
Build/install on emulator and validate playback/focus on physical Android TV hardware.

title: Implement the first SwiftUI and AVPlayer iOS client
goal: Follow docs/clients/IOS.md; do not create a nonfunctional Xcode placeholder.
acceptance: Use generated API models, URLSession cookie/CSRF transport, Keychain storage and version checks.
Prove an authenticated AVPlayer stream with server-authoritative resume on a real device.
Document AVPlayer codec/HLS requirements, local-network privacy prompts and lifecycle behavior.
Set up macOS/Xcode simulator CI and external signing/provisioning for device/TestFlight distribution.
